etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 谷 'valley' (phonetic ヨウ) — a space roomy as a valley under one roof: to contain; what it holds: appearance, content.
mnemonic: A house with a valley's capacity — ヨウ. 内容 is what's inside; 容器 the thing doing the holding.

etymology: Pictograph: a twisted rope with fibers flying — pulling all strands together: to lead (率いる); the proportion of strands: rate, ratio.
mnemonic: One rope, many fibers, one count per hundred — リツ. 確率: how many fibers hold; 率いる: who pulls the rope.

etymology: Phono-semantic: field (田) + 各 (phonetic リャク) — land marked off by plan: to plot (strategy); the plan shortened to its lines: abbreviation.
mnemonic: The campaign map, then the map's shorthand — リャク. 省略: leaving out what the sketch implies.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 卯 (phonetic リュウ) + field (田) — held fast on the land: to stay, to fasten, to detain.
mnemonic: The gate latched with you inside — とまる. 留学 latches you abroad; 留守 is the latched, empty house.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 令 'command' (phonetic リョウ) + head (頁) — the neck and collar, where command takes hold: domain, jurisdiction.
mnemonic: Grab the collar and you steer the coat — リョウ. 大統領: the collar of a whole nation.

etymology: Compound: footsteps (止) passing the granaries under the cliff, season after season — what one has passed through: history, career.
mnemonic: Your footprints past every harvest you've lived — レキ. 履歴書: the footprints, typed up.

etymology: Pictograph: a figure raising a mask over its head — a face not one's own: strange, different.
mnemonic: Both hands lifting a second face — こと(なる). 異常: the mask where the face should be.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a pouch of grain (田) over flesh (月) — the body's grain-sack: the stomach.
mnemonic: The rice bag installed in your torso — イ. 胃が痛い: the bag registering a complaint.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 或 'territory under guard' (phonetic イキ) — land within drawn lines: region, range.
mnemonic: Ground patrolled to its markers — イキ. 地域: your patch of the map.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 于 (phonetic ウ) — the great roof overhead; scaled up, the roof of all things: space.
mnemonic: From your eaves to the universe is one zoom-out — ウ. 宇宙: the house all houses stand in.

etymology: Compound: a stride (廴) with the foot dragging one stroke longer — the road stretched out: to extend, delay.
mnemonic: One more step added every time you think it ends — のびる. 延期: tomorrow's version of today.

etymology: Compound ideograph: fire (火) you can take in hand (厂, originally a hand) — fire cooled to powder: ash.
mnemonic: Fire tame enough to touch — はい. 灰色: the color fire leaves behind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 広 'wide' (phonetic カク) — pushing the edges outward: to expand.
mnemonic: Both palms pressing the walls apart — カク. 拡大: the pinch-zoom kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: an animal hide stretched and scraped on a frame — leather; hide utterly transformed, hence: radical change.
mnemonic: Rawhide worked until it's something new — かわ. 革命: society on the stretching-frame.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 害 (phonetic カツ) + blade (刂) — cut apart: to split; the cut shares: proportion (一割 = 10%).
mnemonic: The knife settles who gets what — わる. 三割引: thirty percent cut off before you pay.

etymology: Compound: hands rolling something around itself (the curled 巳) — to roll up: a scroll, a volume.
mnemonic: Rolled tight from the tail inward — まく. 巻き寿司: the edible edition; 第一巻: volume one.

etymology: Pictograph: a forked pole or drying rack — laundry and fish hung to dry: to dry; poking the pole in: to meddle.
mnemonic: The rack in every Japanese balcony — ほす. 干し物 dries on it; 梅干し survived it.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand (手) shading the eye (目) — peering with care: to watch over, to nurse.
mnemonic: Hand at the brow, scanning the ward — カン. 看護師: the shaded eye that never quite sleeps.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 間 (phonetic カン) — the bamboo writing-slip: brief by necessity: simple, concise.
mnemonic: A message that fits one slat of bamboo — カン. 簡単: complexity that missed the boat.

etymology: Compound ideograph: one figure leaning over the cliff, another crouched beneath — peril above and below: dangerous.
mnemonic: Toes over the edge, someone cowering under the overhang — あぶない. 危険: the sign at the drop.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 几 'low table' (phonetic キ) — the wooden work table: a desk.
mnemonic: A tree flattened into the thing you study kanji on — つくえ. Full circle every evening.

etymology: Compound: a figure stopped mid-step, looking both ways — unable to commit: to doubt, suspect.
mnemonic: Frozen at the fork, weighing everything twice — うたがう. 疑問: the fork, punctuated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 及 'reach' (phonetic キュウ) — the mouth drawing in: to inhale, absorb.
mnemonic: The mouth reaches without moving — すう. 深呼吸: reaching all the way down.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 共 'together' (phonetic キョウ) — presenting with both hands: to offer; the one who accompanies: attendant (子供).
mnemonic: Hands out, offering or tagging along — そなえる, とも. 子供: the small companions; お供え: the offering shelf.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 匈 (phonetic キョウ) — the body's wrapped chamber: the chest.
mnemonic: The ribcage drawn as a parcel around its cargo — むね. 胸がいっぱい: the parcel over capacity.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 堇 (phonetic キン) + strength (力) — strength applied without letup: diligence; applied daily: employment.
mnemonic: Muscle showing up on schedule — つとめる. 通勤: diligence with a train pass.

etymology: Compound: alertness (苟, a figure braced) + the correcting hand (攵) — bearing held straight before authority: respect, reverence.
mnemonic: Back straight, voice careful — うやまう. 敬語: the grammar of standing up straight.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 敬 (phonetic ケイ) + words (言) — the warning spoken with authority: to admonish, guard against.
mnemonic: Respect, with a loudspeaker — ケイ. 警察: the warning, uniformed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 豦 'tiger against boar' (phonetic ゲキ) + blade (刂) — ferocious contest: intensity; staged intensity: drama.
mnemonic: Tiger versus boar with knives: opening night — ゲキ. 劇場: the cage with seats.

etymology: Compound: a contract tally cut in two with the blade (刀) — each party keeps a half: a certificate, a ticket.
mnemonic: The stub torn along the knife-line — ケン. 切符 and 券: proof you paid, in two pieces.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 權): wood (木) + 雚 (phonetic ケン) — originally the steelyard's weighing arm: the power to decide weights: authority, rights.
mnemonic: Whoever holds the scale-arm sets the price — ケン. 権利: your grip on the arm, in law.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 乎 (phonetic コ) — breath pushed out in a shout: to call, to summon; to exhale (呼吸).
mnemonic: The breath that leaves with a name on it — よぶ. 呼吸: the quiet version, out and in.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 呉 (phonetic ゴ) — words gone crooked: error, mis-.
mnemonic: The sentence that left the mouth wrong — あやまる. 誤解: the wrongness, received and grown.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 工 (phonetic コウ) — silk worked into deep red dye: crimson.
mnemonic: The vat where thread learns to blush — べに. 紅葉: the mountains dyeing themselves each fall.

etymology: Compound ideograph: feet stepping down (夅) the mound (阝) — to descend; what descends from the sky: rain and snow (降る).
mnemonic: Down the slope one careful foot at a time — おりる; the sky doing it too — ふる. 降りる the bus, 降る the rain.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 亥 (phonetic コク) + blade (刂) — cut deep and fine: to engrave; time notched in marks: a moment.
mnemonic: Each notch on the timekeeper's board is one 刻 — きざむ. 遅刻: arriving after your notch.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the joint socket (冎) with flesh (月) below — the frame under the meat: bone.
mnemonic: The scaffolding the body rents — ほね. 骨折: a scaffolding incident.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a tree (木) boxed in walls (囗) — growth with nowhere to go: hardship, being stuck.
mnemonic: The tree pressing against all four walls — こまる. 困った…: the sound a boxed tree makes.

etymology: Compound ideograph: stone (石) reduced to its least (少) — rock in crumbs: sand.
mnemonic: Boulders retired into a beach — すな. 砂糖 borrowed the texture for sugar.

etymology: Compound: two people (人人) settled on the ground (土) under a roof (广) — the sitting place: seat, gathering, constellation.
mnemonic: Everyone down on the floor of the hall — すわる. 銀座: 'the silver seat'; 星座: seats assigned to stars.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 濟): water (氵) + 斉 'even' (phonetic サイ) — crossing the water and coming out even: to settle, complete, relieve.
mnemonic: The debt crosses the river and lands squared — すむ. 経済 keeps society's water level; 済みません: 'it never settles' — hence the apology.

etymology: Pictograph: bamboo slips laced together with cord — the ancient book: a volume; the counter for books.
mnemonic: Slats and binding, drawn exactly — サツ. 一冊, 二冊: books counted by their spines' ancestor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 司 'administer' (phonetic シ) — words sorted by function: parts of speech; the words of a song: lyrics.
mnemonic: The grammar office files every word by job — シ. 歌詞: words filed under 'sing'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 志 (phonetic シ) — things set down to be remembered: a record, a journal.
mnemonic: Writing that means to stick around — シ. 雑誌: the record, glossy and monthly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 舎 (phonetic シャ) — the hand letting go: to throw away, abandon.
mnemonic: Open the fingers and walk back to the house — すてる. 捨てる before 拾う: the pair of opposite palms.

etymology: Pictograph: a young figure with arms raised through loose hair — supple youth; borrowed early for 'if, such as'.
mnemonic: Green shoots and easy joints — わかい. 若者: the shoots, plural and loud.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 丩 (phonetic シュウ) + hand (又) — gathering in by hand: to collect, obtain; what comes in: income.
mnemonic: The hand reeling the line back in — おさめる. 収入: whatever the reel brings home.
